title: מתיישבים ויוצאים לדרך
blurb: ישיבה נכונה, מראות, התנעה, הילוכים והשתלבות בטוחה בתנועה – כל מה שעושים לפני ובתחילת הנסיעה.
iconBrief: Flat icon of a car driver's seat seen from inside: steering wheel, rear-view mirror and a fastened seat belt, one clear metaphor of 'getting ready to drive'.
definition: Applies only to questions whose lic tag contains B. The car, the cockpit and the first moments of a trip, from approaching the car until the driver is rolling and merged into traffic, plus basic handling technique. INCLUDES: approaching/entering the car (858); seat, steering wheel, mirror and head-restraint adjustment and what inner/outer mirrors should show (859, 860, 861, 870, 1071, 1072, 1765); panoramic mirror properties (1076, 1699); knowing the controls (862, 869); checks before starting the engine - handbrake on, N/P, clutch/brake pressed, dashboard warning lamps (732, 863, 1044, 1054); automatic-gearbox handling for starting/moving off - P/N to start, foot on brake before moving the lever or releasing the handbrake (738, 739, 741, 1580); choosing a manual gear vs speed/traffic (735, 873); steering-wheel grip (872); looking far ahead and holding a straight line (730, 867, 868); setting off from a stop or kerb and merging into traffic - mirrors, head turn, signal alone is not enough (188, 731, 864, 865, 866); seat belts/airbags/head restraints as injury-limiting devices (1082); refuelling with the engine running (1043); exhaust gas in a closed garage (1061); the legal definition of a road accident (1723, generic basics). EXCLUDED: securing a parked car - handbrake when parking, P plus handbrake, jacking (687, 737, 930, 1063, 1721) goes to safety-park-reverse; routine order of actions when slowing/braking (733, 871, 874), brake failure and puncture while driving (692, 1558) go to safety-speed-gap; downhill gear use incl. automatic downhill (740, 1397, 1483) goes to safety-curves-hills; dirty windshield/headlights (1075, 1608) go to safety-weather-night; reversing goes to safety-park-reverse; motorcycle helmets or tractor equipment go to their vehicle units.

title: אלכוהול, עייפות ותרופות
blurb: למה אסור לנהוג אחרי שתייה, תרופות או כשעייפים – ומה עושים כדי להישאר ערניים.
iconBrief: Flat icon of a car key beside a beer glass with a red prohibition slash, and a small sleepy face or coffee cup, one metaphor of 'not fit to drive'.
definition: Applies only to questions whose lic tag contains B. Fitness of the driver himself (human factor). INCLUDES: alcohol - effects on reaction time, judgement, coordination, peripheral vision, visual acuity, distance/speed estimation, glare recovery, drowsiness; beer vs whisky and 'one type of drink' myths (301, 302, 309, 311-319); drugs and over-the-counter medicines (1389, 1790); fatigue/drowsiness on long drives and its remedies - sleep before, breaks, short break outside the car, stopping to nap (855, 856, 857, 1508, 1509, 1510, 1518, 1550); accidents caused by low alertness (1704); choosing a sober designated driver before going out (1554). EXCLUDED: night dazzle and sun glare (safety-weather-night); keeping a larger following gap when tired (821, safety-speed-gap); generic 'factors that cause loss of control' (1719, safety-speed-gap); definition of an accident (1723, safety-start).

title: מהירות, בלימה ורווח
blurb: כמה מהר לנסוע, כמה מרחק לוקח לעצור, ואיזה רווח לשמור מהרכב שלפניך.
iconBrief: Flat icon of two cars one behind the other with a double-headed arrow between them for the safe gap, and a small stopwatch, one metaphor of 'speed and stopping distance'.
definition: Applies only to questions whose lic tag contains B. How fast am I going, how far do I need to stop, how much gap do I keep. INCLUDES: reasonable/safe speed and control of the vehicle vs speed (444, 807, 1291, 1693); dangers and crash severity of high speed, when one must slow down in general (140, 804, 805, 806, 808); maximum speed on a shown road section (937); reaction distance, braking distance and stopping distance - definitions, components, dependence on speed (654, 660, 809, 810, 811, 812, 813, 1489, 1490, 1491, 1497, 1332); when emergency braking is allowed (145); the routine order of actions before/while slowing - mirrors, off the gas, brakes/gears (733, 871, 874); brake failure and a puncture while driving (692, 1558); factors behind loss of control (1719); following distance - why keep a gap, two-second method, effect on view/fuel/stress, tailgater behind you, bigger gap when visibility/road/alertness is poor or behind large vehicles (814-821, 970, 1531, 1555, 1705); generic dense-traffic, road-works speed limit and 'normal driving' photos (901, 944, 958). EXCLUDED: the gap needed for overtaking (884, 1532) goes to safety-junction-overtake; skid theory and wet-road braking/speed (843-850, 611, 671, 1529, 1701) and 'bigger gap because visibility is poor' (1598) go to safety-weather-night; centrifugal force and downhill braking go to safety-curves-hills; slowing for pedestrians/children/cyclists goes to safety-people; motorcycle braking goes to safety-motorcycle.

title: צמתים, פניות ועקיפות
blurb: איך מתקרבים לצומת, פונים ימינה ושמאלה, מחליפים נתיב ועוקפים בלי לסכן אף אחד.
iconBrief: Flat top-down icon of a four-way junction with two arrows crossing paths and one car curving into a turn, one metaphor of 'paths crossing'.
definition: Applies only to questions whose lic tag contains B. Situations where my path crosses, joins or passes another vehicle's path. INCLUDES: approaching and crossing junctions - workload, many signs before a junction, blocked view (977), do not enter an occupied junction, first action, wet junction (774), waiting at a light (978), who yields and not relying on others to yield (142, 179, 185, 769, 770, 771, 776, 779, 789, 903, 939, 973); right turns including the right-side two-wheeler/dead-zone hazard during the turn (781, 782, 879, 932); left turns and an oncoming left-turner (904); U-turns (794, 797); entering the road from a dirt or side road (881, 938); railway barrier (913); lane-change technique and its risks (760, 761, 762, 763); merging lanes, lane reduction, another vehicle entering your lane (899, 955, 956); overtaking - conditions, distance, several vehicles, horn, oncoming car appearing mid-overtake, aborting, overtaker returning to your lane (257, 772, 822-828, 884, 887, 1532); passing a double-parked car (880); crossing a double solid line (882); a car ahead signalling left (1492). EXCLUDED: pedestrians, children and cyclists as the main subject go to safety-people, including pedestrians at junctions (775, 778, 897, 974), passing a cyclist (907, 1183) and passing a school bus (923); cars leaving/entering a parking spot or shoulder (878, 888, 889, 896, 968, 969) go to safety-park-reverse; keep-right rules, curves and the reason for a solid line (745-750, 949, 972) go to safety-curves-hills; following-distance rules go to safety-speed-gap; motorcycle overtaking or lane-filtering goes to safety-motorcycle.

title: הולכי רגל, ילדים ואופניים
blurb: איך מתנהגים כשיש סביבך הולכי רגל, ילדים ורוכבי אופניים שעלולים להופיע פתאום.
iconBrief: Flat icon of a zebra crossing with a child chasing a ball and a cyclist about to cross in front of a slowing car, one metaphor of 'watch out for people'.
definition: Applies only to questions whose lic tag contains B. Vulnerable road users beside or in front of the car; typical answer is 'slow down, be ready to stop, leave side room'. Mostly photo scenarios. INCLUDES: pedestrians at or near crossings, walking along the roadside, appearing between parked cars, behaving dangerously near junctions, or crossing while I turn (144, 775, 778, 893, 897, 905, 915, 916, 917, 918, 924, 925, 926, 974, 975); children - playing, ball rolling, school bus stopping, car dropping children off, passing a children's bus (906, 908, 909, 910, 914, 922, 923, 1738); cyclists - approaching from behind, passing with side gap, risk of falling into the road, reacting to their movements (898, 907, 942, 954, 1183); car doors opening or people getting out of parked cars (919, 920); urban roads lined with parked cars (892, 921). EXCLUDED: the right-turn danger of a cyclist/two-wheeler beside you during the turn (782, 879) goes to safety-junction-overtake; the driver leaving his own parked car (951) and cars pulling out of parking/shoulder go to safety-park-reverse; motorcycle riders go to safety-motorcycle.

title: חנייה, נסיעה לאחור ושול
blurb: עוצרים, חונים, נוסעים לאחור ויורדים לשול – בלי להפתיע ובלי לפגוע באיש.
iconBrief: Flat icon of a car reversing into a parking space with a small camera/blind-spot cone behind it, one metaphor of 'parking and reversing'.
definition: Applies only to questions whose lic tag contains B. Stopping, parking, reversing, dead zones and the road shoulder. INCLUDES: order of actions for stopping/parking and what is a wrong place to stop - separation island, before a crossing, blocking a bus bay, LPG-car parking, leaving the parked car safely (766, 273, 900, 928, 948, 951); securing a parked vehicle - handbrake when parking, P plus handbrake, keeping the car from moving while it is jacked for a wheel change (687, 737, 930, 1063, 1721); reversing - using a guide, slow pace, dangers and driver limitations (43, 799, 801, 875, 876, 877); the general definition of dead zones and the rear camera (800, 1515, 1754); the shoulder - purpose, who may stop there, planned exit and re-entry, unplanned exit and braking on it, where to stand afterwards (195, 831-838, 890); other vehicles leaving/entering a parking spot or merging from the shoulder (878, 888, 889, 896, 968, 969) and a vehicle stopped on the shoulder ahead (885). EXCLUDED: setting off from a stop or kerb and merging (188, 865, 866) goes to safety-start; the right-turn blind-spot hazard (932) and entering from a dirt road (881, 938) go to safety-junction-overtake; truck/bus dead zones with no B tag (1274, 1511, 1516) go to safety-heavy; pedestrians beside parked cars and opening doors (892, 919, 920, 921, 974) go to safety-people.

title: עקומות, הרים וירידות
blurb: עקומות חדות, כבישי הרים, ירידות ארוכות, גשרים צרים ולמה נוסעים בימין הכביש.
iconBrief: Flat icon of a winding mountain road with a sharp bend and a car keeping to the right edge, small downhill arrow, one metaphor of 'bends and slopes'.
definition: Applies only to questions whose lic tag contains B. Road geometry: the road bends, climbs, descends or narrows, and keeping to the right side. INCLUDES: sharp-curve technique - slow down before, hug the right, accelerate gently on exit, limited sight distance, correct/incorrect position in the bend, road-sign warnings of bends (902, 929, 933, 934, 936, 940, 943, 945, 946, 947, 971, 979, 980, 981, 982, 983, 984, 985, 1679); centrifugal force as a concept and how to reduce it (845, 1480, 1481); mountain roads - features, head-on and brake-loss risk (839, 840, 841, 842); steep or long descents - low gear, minimal brake use, brake overheating, automatic gearbox on a descent (194, 626, 740, 1397, 1483, 1646); why and how to drive on the right side of the road (745, 746, 748, 749, 750, 949); narrow bridge (1523); narrow road with no shoulder (983); solid line marked because sight distance is limited (972). EXCLUDED: skid theory, inertia and friction (843, 844, 846-850) go to safety-weather-night; brake failure (692) goes to safety-speed-gap; overtaking or lane changes (safety-junction-overtake); planned/unplanned exit to the shoulder (831-838) goes to safety-park-reverse; truck-specific descent and load stability (no B tag) go to safety-heavy; motorcycle cornering and leaning goes to safety-motorcycle.

title: לילה, ערפל וכביש חלק
blurb: נהיגה בחושך, בערפל ובסינוור, וגם בגשם, על שמן וחול, בשלוליות ובדרך משובשת.
iconBrief: Flat icon split in two: a moon with a car headlight beam and fog on one side, a rain cloud over a slippery road with skid marks on the other.
definition: Applies only to questions whose lic tag contains B. Poor visibility and poor or slippery road surface. INCLUDES: wet road and the 'first rain' (611, 671, 1529, 1701, 1773, 1791); skid theory - why a car skids, inertia, friction, causes, prevention and mitigation (843, 844, 846, 847, 848, 849, 850); oil, sand, citrus/mud on the road (1292, 1476, 931); flooded road, deep puddle and brake drying afterwards (1006, 1060, 1417, 1690); potholes, cracks and bumpy roads (1293, 1715); fog (895, 1074, 1703); night driving - limited range, distance misjudgment, stopping within headlight range (851, 853, 1697); dazzle from oncoming/high beams and sun glare (852, 854, 1542, 1559, 1563, 1564, 1695, 1709); headlight aim, dirty headlights, daytime lights, dirty windshield (1296, 1298, 1608, 1075); general limited visibility or heavy conditions (952, 953, 1493, 1598); strong side wind and wind resistance (1503, 1534). EXCLUDED: approaching a wet junction (774) goes to safety-junction-overtake; fatigue at night (1550) goes to safety-driver-state; centrifugal force (845) goes to safety-curves-hills; generic speed/stopping-distance concepts go to safety-speed-gap; motorcycle-specific rain/dark/oil riding (lic A only) goes to safety-motorcycle; wind on a tall truck with no B tag (883) goes to safety-heavy.

title: רכיבה על אופנוע
blurb: ציוד מגן, בלימה, פניות, כתמי שמן, מטען ונוסע – איך רוכבים על אופנוע בבטחה.
iconBrief: Flat icon of a motorcycle leaning into a curve with a helmet and gloves beside it, one metaphor of 'riding a motorcycle'.
definition: Mechanical rule: every question whose lic tag is exactly 'lic:A' (49 questions), regardless of topic. Covers helmet/visor/jacket/boots/gloves, side stand, luggage placement, passenger seating and briefing, mirror adjustment, front and rear brake use, brake failure, cornering, leaning and centrifugal force, crossing oil patches and slippery road paint, avoiding obstacles, lane position, safety space, lane-filtering between cars, overtaking as a rider, junction checks for riders, riding in rain/dark, speed and vision. Skippable by B-license learners. EXCLUDED: any question whose lic tag contains B goes to a general unit by topic, even if it mentions motorcycles, cyclists or two-wheelers; tags with no B and no A (C/C1/D, 1) go to safety-heavy or safety-tractor.

title: משאית ואוטובוס
blurb: בטיחות מיוחדת ברכב כבד: יציבות, מרכז כובד, העמסה, נגרר, ירידות ושטחים מתים.
iconBrief: Flat side view of a heavy truck with a trailer beside a bus, with a shaded red blind-spot wedge drawn beside the truck cab.
definition: Mechanical rule: every question whose lic tag has NO B and is a combination of C, C1 and D only - lic:C, lic:C1,C, lic:C1,C,D, lic:D (18 questions). Covers centre of gravity and stability in curves, load placement and containers, trailer/semi-trailer coupling and brake check, jack-knife ('D' state), towing without safety pin/chains, low gear and retarders on long descents, risk of neutral when shifting on a descent, long-vehicle dead zones, side wind on tall trucks, fire extinguishers, sudden braking on a bus, checking dead zones before moving a bus, concrete mixer as a truck. Skippable by B-license learners. EXCLUDED: any question whose lic tag contains B stays in a general unit even if the stem mentions trucks, buses or tankers (e.g. 896, 899, 981, 985 go to park-reverse, junction-overtake and curves-hills); lic:A goes to safety-motorcycle; lic:1 goes to safety-tractor.

title: בטיחות בטרקטור
blurb: בלמים, הידראוליקה, PTO, נעילת דיפרנציאל, משקולות ויציבות בטרקטור.
iconBrief: Flat icon of a farm tractor with big rear wheels, a rear PTO shaft and a hydraulic lift arm raised, one metaphor of 'tractor'.
definition: Mechanical rule: every question whose lic tag is exactly 'lic:1' (28 questions), regardless of topic. Covers service brakes on the rear axle and split-brake use, differential lock, PTO (power take-off) rpm and safety, hydraulic system and pressure release before disconnecting, lift arms, load limit and third-point link, front weights and wheel water ballast, oscillating front axle, tractor rollover response, spark arrester, parking with the loader lowered, detaching implements and trailers on level ground, slow descent with a trailer. Skippable by B-license learners. EXCLUDED: any question whose lic tag contains B or another letter goes to another unit even if it mentions tractors; truck/bus questions (lic C/C1/D) go to safety-heavy.

title: מילון הכביש
blurb: מה זה בעצם צומת, נתיב, זמן תאורה או שביל? כל המושגים שחוזרים בשאלות, במקום אחד.
iconBrief: An open dictionary/book with a tiny road with a dashed centre line drawn coming out of the page, flat style, single metaphor of a dictionary of the road.
definition: Questions whose only point is 'what is / define X' for a GENERAL legal road term that applies to every driver: road (דרך), carriageway (כביש), lane (נתיב, incl. unmarked), shoulder, separation area (plain or built), sidewalk, path (שביל), intersection and its boundary (תחום הצומת), interchange (מחלף), stop line, pedestrian crossing (definition only), rail crossing (definition only), one-way road, night time and lighting time, dimming lights, mixed street, traffic-calming zone (definition), parking (definition, id 12), U-turn (definition, id 793), motor vehicle, private car, 'old' private car (19 years), road user (עובר דרך). Also the picture series 'in the figure of a wide road, which number marks road/lane/shoulder/separation area/way' (82, 101-103, 172), the 'which street is one-way' picture (176), the sidewalk picture (18), and 'who counts as a driver' (pushing a car by hand, 291, 1740). EXCLUDED (go elsewhere): the meaning of 'giving way' and security-vehicle definitions -> law-priority; child seat / booster definitions -> law-passengers-load; points-system definition -> law-obey-penalties; service-brake definition -> law-vehicle-docs; slow vehicle, tractor, ATV, truck, bus, taxi, motorcycle terms -> their vehicle-type unit; any RULE that merely mentions a term (how far from a crosswalk may I park, when may I U-turn, how to behave at a rail crossing) -> the topic unit.

title: רישיון ונוהג חדש
blurb: מי מותר לו לנהוג, מה מתיר רישיון B, ומה הכללים בשנתיים הראשונות כנוהג חדש.
iconBrief: A driver-license card with a photo silhouette and a small green 'new driver' badge on the corner, flat icon.
definition: Getting and holding the right to drive, plus the whole 'new driver' (נוהג חדש) regime. Includes: a valid license for the vehicle type is required and an owner must not let an unlicensed person drive (2, 3); may drive any vehicle of the licensed type if familiar with it (70, 736); license grade B: minimum age 17, what it permits (up to 3,500 kg, private minibus with 8 passengers, a disabled person's special medical vehicle) (329, 333, 91, 1517, 1727, 1225); who cannot get/renew a license (327), license lapsed over 1 year (92), duty to report change of address or health (323, 57, 337, 1311), which doctor examines an applicant (1732), restrictions written on the license such as glasses/lenses (77, 1641), permit needed to drive security/rescue vehicles (331). New driver: 2-year period and validity, escort (who may escort, 3-month escort period, escort must not be under alcohol), the 'new driver' sign, max 2 passengers under age 21 without an escort at the front, offences after which the license is not renewed as a regular license or the person is retested (speeding, drunk/drugged driving, red light/no priority, overtaking, driving without escort, not stopping at a rail crossing) (270, 271, 364, 398, 1674, 1685, 1686, 1688). EXCLUDED: police/authority powers to disqualify, points, court penalties, fines blocking renewal -> law-obey-penalties; general alcohol/drug rules and tests -> law-fit-to-drive; vehicle documents, roadworthiness test, ownership -> law-vehicle-docs; maximum trailer weight for a B holder -> law-passengers-load; grades A/A1/A2 and age 16 -> law-motorcycle; grade 1 -> law-tractor-atv; C1/C/C+E/D grades and age 21 for public vehicles -> truck/bus units.

title: ציות, שוטרים וניקוד
blurb: למי חייבים לציית, ומה קורה אחרי עבירה: פסילות, קנסות ושיטת הניקוד.
iconBrief: A traffic police officer with a raised hand signalling stop, next to a small points/score badge, flat icon.
definition: Obedience and the state's response to offences. Includes: general duty to know and obey traffic law, to be careful and not harm others' right to use the road (1, 481, 1768); obeying signs (58); a traffic light takes precedence over a yield-sign except flashing yellow (59, 69, this stays here and NOT in law-priority); obeying uniformed police, an officer with ID (even against signs), military police, municipal inspector, road-works staff, temporary signs set by police (60-68); obeying an officer/signal when a lane is blocked (191). Police powers: detaining an offender, officer disqualifying a license for 30/60/90 days, penalty for driving while disqualified (5-9). Licensing-authority powers: suspend/disqualify, summon for a refresher, withhold renewal over unpaid traffic fines (335, 336, 1775, 1788). Court penalties (237). Points system: what it is, 12-22 points (course + test), 36+ points (3-month suspension + theory test), validity of points, administrative measures on top of court punishment (52, 127, 220, 242, 269, 366, 379). Who is held liable: owner's absolute liability, camera-detected offence, illegally parked car (264, 290, 1736). EXCLUDED: alcohol/drug tests and refusing a breath test (even though a police officer demands it) -> law-fit-to-drive; new-driver-specific consequences of a conviction -> law-license-new-driver; police 'non-use' notice, vehicle inspection summons, pollution stops -> law-vehicle-docs; police weighing of a truck and stopping an illegally loaded truck -> law-truck-cargo; accident reporting duties -> law-accident-breakdown; who yields first at a junction -> law-priority.

title: שכרות, תרופות וטלפון
blurb: מתי אסור לנהוג בכלל: אלכוהול, סמים, תרופות, טלפון ביד או מסך שמסיח את הדעת.
iconBrief: A beer glass and a smartphone each crossed by a red prohibition circle, above a steering wheel, flat icon.
definition: The driver's condition and distraction. Includes: alcohol and drugs (295, 303, 1552), sedatives and medication affecting driving (72, 1525, 1720), a physical or mental condition that endangers others (71), the breath test (what it is, police may demand it at any time, the driver must comply, refusing = counted as drunk, accepted as court evidence), blood/urine/saliva test on reasonable suspicion, the legal alcohol limit and 'drunk' definition (297-300, 305-308), mobile phone (hands-free only), SMS (76, 399), screens/GPS display visible to the driver (354), taking a hand off the wheel or handlebar (only for gear change/indicator) (75, 1717). EXCLUDED: alcohol/drug convictions as a bar to renewing a new-driver license (271, 1686) and an escort under alcohol (296) -> law-license-new-driver; general police powers, disqualification, points -> law-obey-penalties; glasses restrictions and reporting health changes -> law-license-new-driver.

title: הרכב: מסמכים ותקינות
blurb: אילו מסמכים חייבים להיות ברכב, טסט והעברת בעלות, ומה נחשב רכב תקין וציוד חובה.
iconBrief: A vehicle-registration paper with a green checkmark and a small wrench, flat icon.
definition: Paperwork and roadworthiness of an ordinary car (B-tagged). Documents: which papers the driver must carry (driver license, vehicle license, compulsory insurance), keeping them in the car, clean and legible, copies only for corporate owners, showing originals to an officer, ban on altering documents, the vehicle license must be held by the driver even if not the owner (49, 50, 51, 53, 56, 251). Administration: annual roadworthiness test (149), ownership transfer conditions and who is responsible (341, 342), notifying non-use over a month (343), two number plates (344), who may summon a car for a technical inspection (345). Notice of non-use ('הורדה מהכביש'): what it is and what it allows, issued by police/technician/inspector, incl. for pollution (41, 95, 346, 1488, 1294, 1295). Condition: unsafe vehicle (73), limited forward field of view (74), oil leak/smoke over the legal level and who is responsible (304, 1714), unreasonable noise and who is responsible (250, 284), owner and driver responsible for condition (478), brake warning light on (1713), tyre tread 2 mm incl. spare (1501), structural changes need prior written approval (1568), working speedometer (348), service-brake definition (1376). Mandatory equipment of an ordinary car: fire extinguisher (which vehicles, where kept) (352, 1286, 1325), litter basket (353), mud guards (1366). EXCLUDED: lights and extra lamps -> law-signals-lights; warning triangle and reflective vest -> law-accident-breakdown; police weighing/non-use for overweight trucks -> law-truck-cargo; truck/bus/taxi equipment (chocks, tachograph, hammers, ABS on taxi) -> their vehicle-type unit; police powers, points -> law-obey-penalties; license eligibility -> law-license-new-driver.

title: נוסעים, ילדים ומטען
blurb: חגורות בטיחות, מושבי ילדים, כמה נוסעים מותר, גרירה והובלת מטען ברכב פרטי.
iconBrief: A car seat with a fastened seat belt and a small child booster seat beside it, flat icon.
definition: People and loads in or on an ordinary car (B-tagged questions). Seat belts: in which vehicles, who is responsible incl. a rear-seat passenger, exemption when reversing (22, 235, 236). Child restraints by age (under 1 rear-facing, under 3 safety seat, age 3-8 seat or booster) and the definitions of safety seat and booster (46, 47, 230-233). Number of passengers beside the driver, max passengers in a light commercial vehicle up to 3,500 kg (229, 238). Body outside the car, open door while driving, opening doors while moving, boarding/exiting while moving, passengers entering/exiting on the traffic side (224-228). Carrying paying passengers in a private car is forbidden (38, 239). No people in a vehicle being towed (241).
